Probiotics

Supplement probiotic gut immune digestion flora

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Beneficial live microorganisms that support gut flora balance, immune function, and digestive health.

Indications

  • digestive disorders
  • immune deficiency
  • antibiotic recovery
  • yeast overgrowth
  • IBS
  • diarrhea

Contraindications

  • severe immune suppression
  • small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO)

Preparations

  • capsule
  • tablet
  • powder
  • fermented foods

Body Systems Affected

  • digestive
  • immune
  • endocrine

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Irritable Bowel Syndrome
    Functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits (diarrhea or constipation).
  • Heavy Metal Toxicity
    Accumulation of toxic metals like lead, mercury, cadmium in body tissues.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Anxiety & Stress
    Psychological state of worry, nervousness, or fear that is difficult to control and affects daily functioning.
  • Gut Dysbiosis
    Imbalance of beneficial gut bacteria leading to digestive issues and compromised immunity.
  • Erectile Dysfunction
    Inability to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for sexual intercourse.
  • Gout
    Form of inflammatory arthritis characterized by recurrent attacks of a red, tender, hot, and swollen joint.
